title: Kinds of problem are still being learned; the three-axis stance may relate to kinds (2026-11-03)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: We have multiple kinds and this is still something that we need to learn more about. srs-programme should have some records of the research we have been doing to classify kinds of decisions. We have clusters, we also have the trigram based 3 axis polarity notes. We can classify on the axes pretty reliably. This is a stance that may relate to kinds.
